core_obligations: The author uses foliated Plateau solutions and equidistributed quasi-Fuchsian k-surfaces to relate modified energy counts to conformal-current/laminar measures. Quantitative counting and rigidity of near-umbilical surface energies establish the hyperbolic entropy extremum and the equivalence between normalized energy-entropy equalities and constant sectional curvature.

dedup.scope: Same-source public2369 is rigidity of the marked positive-energy spectrum. Both entropy theorems form one object. Ordinary counting entropies are not substituted without the original extra no-totally-geodesic-surface condition; all marked-spectrum statements remain context.
